scope: Original query routines execute against their matching two-qword interface identifier and supplied this-pointer storage. Matching identifiers only; no native object construction, delegated query failure, scene traversal, combined target finalization, evaluator execution or GUI.

childCountEvidence.observation: Iterates ordered children, queries 0x141164be0, and sums the count returned by virtual slot +0x18 on the vertex container at payload +0x48.

interpretation: For the concrete cMesh query, raw-mesh identity 0x141164ba0 and alignment child-payload identity 0x141164be0 are aliases returning the same payload root. This does not establish support or exclusion for other concrete classes.
